reviewMethod: Fifty distinct focused source audits covering design, syntax, migration, calibration and example convergence. sourceReviewPasses.decision: The compiler accepts a return-true implementation for value is string; introduce a source policy rather than pretending TypeScript proves that annotation.
A predicate also narrows the false branch. A schema boolean wrapper cannot promise all strings when it accepts only a refined subset.
Keep no-contradictory-type-predicate and no-partial-type-predicate as correctness controls; they deliberately cover narrower proofs and do not own a policy ban.
Check a discriminated union directly after values enter the typed domain. A tag on unknown JSON does not validate the payload.
Allow inferred null filters and discriminator helpers: no handwritten is claim exists to drift from the implementation.
Include asserts value is T under the same policy; leave plain asserts condition outside the explicit type-promise scope.
Use the shared generated/declaration exclusions and preserve consumption of imported library guards. Authored signatures in .ts remain checked.
No automatic annotation deletion: public callbacks, false-branch consumers and overloads can change. Follow mandatory warning-first lifecycle and check local exact-rule suppression semantics.

repositoryCalibration.selection: Complete tracked TypeScript implementation, tests, configuration and scripts in the disclosed standards-plugin, tool and documentation roots; dedicated fixtures excluded. The initial immutable source pin is retained after integrating newer main. Exact paths, source and identifying hashes stay local.
repositoryCalibration.review: Every finding was inspected and reconciled with the source inventory. These are requested design-policy matches, not demonstrated runtime defects.
repositoryCalibration.inlineDirectives: Ignored only for isolated single-rule classification; exact native suppressions and unused-directive tests remain mandatory.

performance.method: Incremental cost of enabling the new rule versus the exact main plugin with no policy visitor: same parser, inputs and pinned Node. Three balanced fresh processes per mode and four warm native passes per process. Every eleventh source file after SHA256 path ranking; filesystem cache uncontrolled and shared-host load limits timing attribution. Candidate also incorporates the reconciled main React follow-up; process-wall/startup includes plugin-load changes. Only the new visitor runs; inline configuration is disabled identically for isolated measurement.
performance.limits: Single-rule enablement versus a parser-only baseline; no estimate of full-preset cost, fleet overhead, general speedup or memory bound. Shared-host load and filesystem caches are uncontrolled. Process wall includes plugin-load differences from the reconciled React follow-up.

boundaries: Compiler-inferred predicates, direct tags, ordinary boolean returns, plain asserts condition and imported guard consumption remain allowed.
Generated, vendored and declaration files retain shared exclusions; maintained tests remain checked.
A discriminator on unknown data does not validate its payload. Consume schema data or its result discriminator; do not repeat an unchecked narrowing promise around safeParse.
No automatic annotation deletion: public callbacks, overloads, both branches, declaration output and compiler versions need caller review.
Seven exact local exceptions preserve native policy-table keys, readonly arrays, generic option tuples, parser-service identity and parser-key AST reflection.
Finite labeled and repository calibration does not establish universal precision or recall.
deliveryQualification: Required separately: complete make verify, every native commit/push hook, all latest exact-head required checks and classic statuses, canonical aggregate CI artifact, exact-head admin squash and merged-tree/main-ancestry verification.
